extDescription.message: Clip a selection or a page to Graphium running on this computer.

cmdClip.message: Clip the selection (or the page) to Graphium

titleQueued.message: Graphium is not reachable. Saved to send later.

titleBadUrl.message: Only http/https pages can be clipped.

titleUnauthorized.message: The connection to Graphium no longer works (the code may have been renewed). Connect again in the settings.

titleNotPaired.message: Not connected to Graphium yet. Open the settings and press "Connect to Graphium".

optHelp.message: The code is in Graphium under Settings → Storage → Send from your phone or browser → Web clip.

optInvalid.message: The code format is not valid.

optUnreachable.message: Cannot reach Graphium. Is the app running?

titleRejected.message: Graphium could not accept this clip (the page address or the text is not supported).

optConnectHelp.message: With Graphium running, press the button below. When Graphium asks whether to connect, check that the number matches and press Allow.

optPairWaiting.message: Check that Graphium shows the same number, then press Allow in Graphium.

optPairDenied.message: Graphium did not allow the connection.

optPairExpired.message: The request timed out. Press the button again.

optPairUnsupported.message: This Graphium does not support connecting with the button. Paste the code under "More settings" below.

optAdvanced.message: More settings (port, connect by pasting a code)

optPortHelp.message: Leave it at 3001 unless you connect to a self-hosted server.

optInvalidPort.message: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535.
